name: who is whois
description: THJCC 2026 / who is whois: User-controlled data is concatenated into an OS command executed through a shell instead of being passed as an argument vector. Injection type is Command Injection. Attack surface: web parameters feeding utility endpoints (ping, dns, convert, archive, render) that shell out. Recommended strategy: The handler does args = ["whois"] + shlex.split(raw) and runs subprocess.run without a shell, so shell metacharacters are useless. What remains is argument injection: shlex.split lets the attacker supply additional flags to whois. Abuse whois options that control the server or the output file to read attacker-chosen data, and pair it with the TOTP gate that guards the privileged path.
vuln_type: Argument injection into whois via shlex.split (no shell)
